gameDescriptionHtml:
You’ve been unfairly laid off by Mega Corp and the news kills you. Literally. But your restless ghost has unfinished business…revenge! ‘Restructure’ this corporate behemoth one department at a time, unleashing hilarious physics-based chaos as you uncover their diabolical secrets.

WORK SUCKS. BREAK STUFF!

Ignore the OHS rules and blast your way through each floor. Each room has physics to play with, destructible environments and a variety of different mechanics to keep you entertained.

Ever wanted to have a go at your boss? We don’t recommend doing that in real life but you can do it here! Every boss has their own abilities and move sets to really test your mettle.

Vary up your office combat with over 45 different fight moves. Each move has different impacts on the environment so the possibilities are endless!

Our character creator will let you make just about anyone. With hundreds of clothing items to choose from, there’s something for everyone here.

Climb the corporate ladder, and not by promotion, but by force. Collect soul coins, purchase new fight moves, and brawl with more style. Runes will modify the way you play so you can do it all over again but with added effects. We’ve got zero gravity, black holes, multi-throw, and much much more.
